India at UN criticizes Pakistan over minority rights and nuclear threats

India's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ruchira Kamboj, criticized Pakistan at the UN, stating that while Pakistan lectures others on the rule of law, its own country is governed by the army. Kamboj also addressed Pakistan's accusations regarding minority rights in India and its nuclear threats. The Indian delegation highlighted that Pakistan has a history of harboring terrorists and has not taken credible action against them. The statement also pointed out Pakistan's own internal issues with minority rights and its use of terrorism as state policy.
